devdoc.details: The billing contract allows for Graph Tokens to be added by a user. The token can then be pulled by a permissioned set of users named 'collectors'. It is owned and controlled by the 'governor'.

InsufficientBalanceForRemoval(address,ad.details: User tried to remove tokens from L1, but they did not have enough balance

TokensPulled(address,uint256).details: Gateway pulled tokens from a user

acceptOwnership().details: Admin function for pending governor to accept role and update governor. This function must called by the pending governor.

add(uint256).details: Ensure graphToken.approve() is called on the billing contract first

addTo(address,uint256).details: Ensure graphToken.approve() is called on the billing contract first

params._to: Address that tokens are being added to

addToMany(address[],uint256[]).details: Ensure graphToken.approve() is called on the billing contract first

params._amount: Array of amount of tokens to add to each account
params._to: Array of addresses where to add tokens

constructor.details: Note that the l1BillingConnector address must be provided afterwards through setL1BillingConnector, since it's expected to be deployed after this one.

onTokenTransfer(address,uint256,bytes).details: Expects an `address user` in the encoded _data.

params._amount: Amount of tokens that were transferred
params._data: ABI-encoded callhook data: contains address that tokens are being added to

params._user: Address that tokens are being pulled from

params._amounts: Amounts of tokens to pull from each user
params._users: Addresses that tokens are being pulled from

remove(address,uint256).details: Tokens will be removed from the sender's balance

params._to: Address that tokens will be sent to

removeFromL1(address,address,uint256).details: This can only be called from the BillingConnector on L1. If the user does not have enough balance, rather than reverting, this function will succeed and emit InsufficientBalanceForRemoval.

params._from: Address from which the tokens are removed

params._to: Destination address to send the tokens
params._token: Token address of the token that was accidentally sent to the contract

params._enabled: True to set the _collector address as a Collector, false to remove it

params._l1BillingConnector: New address for the L1 BillingConnector (without any aliasing!)

params._l2TokenGateway: New address for the L2 token gateway

transferOwnership(address).details: Admin function to begin change of governor. The `_newGovernor` must call `acceptOwnership` to finalize the transfer.

constructor.notice: Constructor function for the Billing contract
